The '''ruined Rakata machine chamber''' was the name given to one of the ice caverns that made up [[the Tomb]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. It was named for the massive [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] machine that occupied the center of the cavern; one of the machine's supports had collapsed and sent the structure crashing to the ground by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic War]]. The [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] established the [[Imperial remote post]] there in their efforts to locate the [[Dread Masters]] in [[Vault 914]], which was located in the cavern, but the Imperials at the post were wiped out by the [[Esh-kha]].
